name: FreshRSS
description: FreshRSS is a lightweight RSS and Atom feed aggregator. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys FreshRSS as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Lightweight RSS and Atom feed reader. Deploy FreshRSS with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
